ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, after the input terminal at the upper left end, a series resistor R is connected; the right end of the resistor is connected to the output node on the right side; this output node is then connected vertically through a capacitor C to the lower common wire. Therefore the output v_o(t) is taken across the two ends of the capacitor, that is, the parallel capacitor node voltage after the series R. Reasoning: This is an RC low-pass circuit, with the output across the capacitor, and the transfer function is H(jω)=1/(1+jωRC). It is known that RC=1 ms=10^-3 s, and the input v_i(t)=√2 sin(10^3 t), so ω=10^3 rad/s, ωRC=10^3×10^-3=1. Therefore H(jω)=1/(1+j), the magnitude is 1/√2, and the phase is -45°. The input amplitude √2 multiplied by 1/√2 gives the output amplitude 1, and the phase lags by 45°, so v_o(t)=sin(10^3t-45°).

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个一阶 RC 低通网络：输入端 V1(t) 经过上方串联电阻 R 到达右侧输出节点；该输出节点通过电容 C 接到底部公共参考线；输出 V0(t) 取在电容两端，也就是输出节点相对于底部参考线的电压。推理：对输出节点列 KCL，流过电阻的电流等于流入电容的电流：(vi - vo)/R = C dvo/dt，因此 RC dvo/dt + vo = vi。已知 RC = 1 ms = 10^-3 s，vi(t) = √2 sin(10^3 t)，所以方程为 10^-3 dvo/dt + vo = √2 sin(10^3 t)。设稳态输出 vo = A sin(10^3 t) + B cos(10^3 t)。则 10^-3 dvo/dt = A cos(10^3 t) - B sin(10^3 t)。代入后得到 (A - B) sin(10^3 t) + (A + B) cos(10^3 t) = √2 sin(10^3 t)。比较系数：A - B = √2，A + B = 0。解得 A = 1/√2，B = -1/√2。因此 vo(t) = (1/√2)sin(10^3 t) - (1/√2)cos(10^3 t) = sin(10^3 t - 45°)。
